A company in Gex.

Création & Rénovation Gessienne supports your masonry and interior improvement projects, with one simple starting point: understanding what you need.

Transform
the space around you.

Our company is based in Gex, in the Ain department of France. Working in the building sector since 2022, we bring together several complementary trades: masonry, plastering, partitions and tiling.

Changing a layout, creating a partition or replacing a finish: every project has its own context. Discussing the existing space, its uses and its constraints helps define the works to consider.

Please confirm the town where the works will take place and the site conditions when you first contact us.
